## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Stories:**

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to create new requirements with unique and permanent identifiers,
**So that** I can easily reference and track requirements.

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to format text within linkable sections,
**So that** I can create visually appealing and informative requirements.

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to store external requirements assets,
**So that** I can easily reference and share external resources.

**As a** Requirement Importer,
**I want** to be able to import content from other requirements management tools,
**So that** I can consolidate my requirements into one platform.

**As a** Requirement Exporter,
**I want** to be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools,
**So that** I can share my requirements with other teams.

**As a** Requirement Viewer,
**I want** to be able to view requirements as a document,
**So that** I can easily understand the overall structure of the requirements.

**As a** Requirement Viewer,
**I want** to be able to view document items interactively,
**So that** I can explore specific requirements in detail.

**As a** Requirement Versioner,
**I want** to be able to baseline versions of requirements,
**So that** I can track changes and maintain version history.

**User Roles:**

* Requirement Creator
* Requirement Importer
* Requirement Exporter
* Requirement Viewer
* Requirement Versioner
